info.name: BrevioAI API Ultimate Edition
info.description:
Exhaustive Postman collection for the current BrevioAI FastAPI backend (`core/brevio_api`).

**Base URL:** `http://localhost:8000` (uvicorn). Frontend uses the same origin. OpenAPI: `/api/openapi.json`, Swagger: `/api/docs`.

**Auth**
- Public: `/auth/*`
- Session cookies (httpOnly) `brevio_access` + `brevio_refresh`. Login/register/refresh set them; JSON does not return the JWT. Bearer is optional fallback.
- `X-API-KEY` (`{{api_key}}`): catalog GETs and YouTube count utils only

**Error envelope:** `{ "status": "error", "message": "...", "signature": {...}, "code"?: "FOLDER_NOT_FOUND" }`
**Success envelope (most routes):** `{ "status": "success", "data": {...}, "signature": {...} }`
Library folders, credentials, bulk entry ops, and SSE do **not** wrap in that envelope.

**Removed vs previous collection:** `/billing/estimate-media` and `/billing/estimate-documents` (billing router deleted). Use `POST /brevio/estimate-documents`.

**Enums (representative)**
- Languages: enum **names** (`ENGLISH`, `SPANISH`, `FRENCH`, …) not ISO codes
- Categories: `simple_summary`, `journalism`, `marketing`, `health`, `technology`, `education`, `architecture`, `finance`, `tourism`, `requirements`, `sciences`
- Styles (by category): education=`guide|quick_ref|timeline`, technology=`changelog|proposal|diagram`, journalism=`chronicle|news_wire|analysis`
- Formats: `html`, `markdown`, `json`, `text`
- Summary levels: `very_concise`, `concise`, `moderate`, `detailed`, `very_detailed`
- Models: `gpt-4`, `gpt-4o-mini`, `gemini-3.1-flash-lite`, `deepseek-flash`, `qwen3:8b`, `qwen3:14b`, `qwen3:14b-q6`, `qwen3:32b`, `deepseek-r1-local:iq3-xs`, `gpt-oss:20b`, `batiai/gemma4-31b:iq3`
- Job status: `PROCESSING` | `COMPLETED` | `FAILED`

Login / register set httpOnly cookies. Create-folder / create-credential / summary jobs persist IDs.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Public endpoints. Login/register save `{{token}}`. Identity is email **or** username (3–10 chars `[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]` if not email). Register password: ≥8 chars, 1 upper, 1 lower, 1 digit, 1 special.

request.description:
Authenticate with `identity` (username or email) and `password`. Sets httpOnly cookies `brevio_access` and `brevio_refresh`. JSON returns `{ authenticated: true }` and does **not** include the JWT.

**Errors:** 401 invalid credentials · 422 validation.

response.name: 422 Validation

request.description: Same login using an email as `identity`.
Creates the user, a root folder, and returns `access_token` plus `folder` (`success`/`message`). Username 6–25 chars.

item.name: Library Folders
item.description: User-created folders for organizing summaries. Deleting a folder does **not** delete summaries (they become unfiled).

request.description: Returns `{ folders, unfiled_count }`. Not wrapped in the standard data envelope.
Creates a folder. Blank/whitespace names → `400 FOLDER_NAME_INVALID`. Duplicate names → `400 FOLDER_NAME_DUPLICATE`.
Renames an owned folder.
Deletes the folder object only. Summaries stay and become unfiled.

item.name: Entries
item.description: Summary jobs / store items. `GET /users/entries?folder_id=unfiled` lists unfiled. Empty list is 200, not 404.

request.description: Lists every folder entry for the user. Optional `folder_id` filters by library folder; use `unfiled` for items without a folder.
Same list endpoint filtered to one library folder.
Fetches specific entries by ObjectId. Used by the frontend job poller. 404 if none match. 400 invalid ObjectId. 403 if another user's entries.

request.description: Moves one or more summaries. `library_folder_id: null` unfiles them. Returns `{ succeeded, failed: [{ id, code }] }`.
Same move endpoint with `library_folder_id: null`.
Deletes one or more owned summaries. Best-effort filesystem cleanup under `data/{folder_id}/{entry_id}`.
Rename and/or move a single summary. Omit a field to leave it unchanged. `library_folder_id: null` unfiles.
Deletes one owned folder entry and its on-disk directory (best-effort).

item.name: User Credentials
item.description: JWT required. Encrypted provider API keys. Responses never include the plaintext key. Local provider `ollama` cannot store user keys. Known paid providers: `openai`, `deepseek`, `google`.

request.description: Active credentials for every provider.
Active credentials for one provider (`openai`, `deepseek`, `google`, …).

Validates the key against the provider, encrypts it, and stores it. `name` 1–80 chars (required). `is_default` optional.

**400:** empty key, unknown provider, local provider, invalid key, duplicate name.

response.name: 400 Invalid key
400 Local provider
422 Validation

request.description: Marks this credential as the default for its provider (clears default on siblings).
Renames without exposing or changing the API key. Empty name → 400.
Soft-delete: status becomes `revoked`. 204 empty body.

item.name: Events (SSE)
item.description: JWT required. Server-Sent Events for summary job completion/failure. Heartbeat comments every ~15s (`EVENTS_SSE_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS`). Replay missed events with `Last-Event-ID`.

header.description: Replay events after this id (`0` = from start of buffer)

request.description:
Subscribe to user-scoped job events.

**Headers:** `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`, `Accept: text/event-stream`, optional `Last-Event-ID`.

Frames:
- comment `: connected`
- keepalive `: keepalive`
- `event: summary.completed` or `event: summary.failed`

Payload fields: `type`, `job_id`, `document_id`, `status` (`COMPLETED`|`FAILED`), `timestamp`, `event_id`, `document_name`, optional `error: { code, message }`.

Postman may hold the connection; stop the request to disconnect. Query `user_id` is ignored (auth only).

item.name: Estimation
item.description: JWT required. Local token/cost estimate for PDF/DOCX — **does not** call the LLM. Replaces the deleted `/billing/*` routes.

request.description:
multipart/form-data: `files` (.pdf / .docx) plus prompt fields (`language`, `model`, `category`, `style`, `format`, `summary_level`). Optional repeated `source_types` (`pdf`, `docx`, `text`, `video`, `audio`, `media`, `image`).

Does **not** accept `library_folder_id`. Invalid extension → 415. Style/source mismatch → 422.
